messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - routing-service errors detected. spike in 5xx and misrouted variant responses. Pager: @roger.oncall
roger.oncall: ack — I'm on it. seeing a surge in 5xx and a pattern where responses look like the wrong model variant (format/structure off). tagging infra + ML.
luis.m: quick tail from smart-router logs (raw):
```
[2026-03-15T11:12:05Z] route_eval: key=kv:route:us-east-1::modelA::null_variant -> hit
[2026-03-15T11:12:06Z] route_eval: key=kv:route:us-east-1::modelB::null_variant -> hit
[2026-03-15T11:12:07Z] route_eval: decision=modelB fallback=closest_variant
```
Looks like the variant id is missing from the cache key after the recent key-normalization refactor — two different model variants collapsing to the same key.
infra-jen: that aligns with the routing PR note. PR #8421 shortened the key to region+model to dedupe, but dropped the variant suffix. Mitigation proposal: 1) disable variant fallback policy temporarily; 2) invalidate affected routing cache prefixes; 3) rollback the key-change PR if needed.
roger.oncall: running mitigation now:
```
# disable fallback policy
rdctl config set routing.fallback.enabled false --env prod
# invalidate cache prefix in region
rdctl cache invalidate --prefix "kv:route:us-east-1"
```
roger.oncall: applied config change, issuing invalidate for us-east-1. starting invalidation for eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1.
incidents-bot: update: responders = @roger.oncall, @infra-jen, @luis.m, @cs-kate
sarah.h: SRE lead — keep a tight timeline here. CS, what customers are affected? severity assessment?
cs-kate: affected list so far: AcmeCorp (high QPS), MoneyFleet, EduStream. Acme saw malformed outputs and elevated 5xx in the 11:10-11:20 window. Working on impact counts.
luis.m: the offending commit: https://git.internal/r/8421 — note the key change in routing/cache.go. I recommend rollback to restore variant suffix while we add tests.
roger.oncall: initiating rollback of that change on routing-service.
deploy-bot: rollback triggered for routing-service -> routing-service@2026-03-15-11:05 (targeted).
deploy-bot: rollback in progress...
roger.oncall: rollback finished, routing-service running routing-service@2026-03-15-11:05. logs show variant id being appended to keys again.
infra-jen: running cross-region cache flush to avoid stale collisions. Command (safety-first):
```
for r in us-east-1 eu-west-1 ap-southeast-1; do
  rdctl cache invalidate --prefix "kv:route:$r" --concurrency 4 || echo "invalidate failed $r"
done
```
roger.oncall: invalidation jobs dispatched, watching propagation. initial metric check shows error rate dropping.
roger.oncall: after rollback + flush: error rate fell from 6.2% -> 0.5% over a 10m window. token failures and wrong-variant responses back to baseline. :white_check_mark:
sarah.h: great work. Customer impact summary: AcmeCorp ~12 failed requests, MoneyFleet ~4, EduStream intermittent. CS to notify Acme with timeline and mitigation. Owners: luis -> RCA + PR fix (include unit/e2e test for variant in cache key), infra-jen -> add cross-region invalidate runbook and test, roger -> update oncall runbook + monitoring alerts.
cs-kate: outbound draft prepared, will include timeline and offer for SLA credit where appropriate. :memo:
roger.oncall: will keep monitoring for 60m and then transition to normal rotation.
incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 1932104789 — P0 -> mitigated. Please file postmortem and link runbook.
sarah.h: filing postmortem now and assigning tasks. closing this thread in 24h unless any regressions.
cs-kate: note for PM: customer requested a short RCA summary and confirmation that fix included tests.
roger.oncall: thanks everyone — fast detection and rollback saved the day. Pls add any follow-ups to the postmortem. :thumbsup:
